Definition: from G4745; a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy:--Stoick.
BiblicalUsage: The Stoics are the philosophers of the porch who meet Paul in Athens. Certain philosophers of the Epicureans and of the Stoicks encountered him, and some said, What will this babbler say? They heard him preach Jesus and the resurrection.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Stoics met the one thing their porch never gave them: a risen man, and a hope their fate could not offer.
